messages:
zoe: Quick note from the morning sketch sesh 12 — added a compact "playback" control to the rollout timeline so PMs can step through traffic shifts without opening the full inspector. prototype: https://redwood.internal/prototypes/timeline-playback-compact.png

marta: I like it. Two immediate concerns: 1) discoverability (users might miss the small control) and 2) accidental activation on mobile when scrolling.

aria: Accessibility: playback needs clear SR states. Propose announcements: on play start -> "Previewing rollout snapshot 1 of 4: checkout-service, 10% to v2"; on step -> "Now showing snapshot 2 of 4"; on stop -> "Preview paused". Also respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a non-animated jump option.

sam: Copy/UI: instead of a generic play icon, label it "Preview" on desktop and use an icon-only button on mobile. Include a small persistent hint under the timeline header: "Preview changes" so discoverability improves.

kevin: Implementation notes: we'll debounce SR announces to avoid flood (max 1 announce per 700ms). For keyboard: space toggles play/pause, arrows step. Add a hidden live region with the snapshot summary for SRs. Also guard against stale previews if live state changes mid-play (show "preview snapshot stale" badge).

marta: Motion detail: if we animate the timeline, ensure focus moves back to the playback control after each step so keyboard users don't lose place. But aria: don't trap focus in the control.

deploy-bot: Canary allocation changed by @ops-team: checkout-service now 15% -> 20% to v2.

aria: Good catch. If live changes while a preview is running we should surface a toast: "Live state changed 12 preview paused". That keeps users from assuming preview reflects live traffic.

zoe: I'll inflate the control a touch on mobile and add the textual hint. I'll also mock a reduced-motion variant.

sam: Microcopy agree: desktop label "Preview"; mobile tooltip "Preview changes"; toast copy: "Live state changed 12 preview paused. Click resume to continue from current snapshot."

kevin: Spike plan: I'll implement a feature-flagged prototype on staging with SR mirror + live-region and reduced-motion handling. ETA: 2 days.

marta: Next steps: zoe uploads updated comps, kevin spikes, aria + QA run VoiceOver/NVDA checks, sam finalizes copy. ETA: EOD Friday.

sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
